caption:
OpenAI and Intuit just announced a $100M+ multi-year partnership to bring Intuit app experiences directly inside ChatGPT.

Here is why this matters: ChatGPT is transitioning from a standalone chatbot into a full operating platform. By embedding tools like TurboTax and QuickBooks directly into frontier models, financial management is moving into conversational interfaces.

What app ecosystem do you think moves into ChatGPT next?
